film, animation, grain, stillimage, psnr, ssim, fastdecode or zerolatency - Tune for a type of source
baseline, main, high, high10, high422 or high444 - Force the limits of a profile
Decoder level to comply with, e.g. 4.1
0-16 (default 3) - B-frames between I and P frames
0-2 (default 1) - How B-frame placement is decided: 0 off, 1 fast, 2 optimal
1-16 (default 3) - Reference frames the motion search may use
0-250 (default 40) - Frames looked ahead when deciding frame types
0-3 (default 1) - Adaptive quantisation: 0 off, 1 variance, 2 auto-variance, 3 with dark-scene bias
Float (default 1.0) - Reduces blocking and blurring in flat and textured areas
rd:trellis floats (default 0.0:0.0) - Strength of the psychovisual optimisation
dia, hex, umh, esa or tesa (default hex) - Integer pixel motion estimation method
0-11 (default 7) - Subpixel motion estimation and mode decision quality
Integer (default 16) - Largest motion vector search range
0.0-1.0 (default 0.60) - QP curve compression; 1.0 behaves like constant QP
kbit/s - Ceiling on local bitrate, for decoder compliance
kbit - Size of the VBV buffer, used with vbv-maxrate
